Issuer: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
Summary: EIOPA’s advice proposes simplifying (re)insurance Taxonomy disclosures while improving their transparency and comparability and preserving reliable information on environmentally sustainable insurance activities.
title: EIOPA's Final Advice on the review of (re)insurance disclosures under the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act

Issuer: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
Summary: EIOPA invites stakeholders, particularly financial analysts, rating agencies and consultancy firms, to share views on the indicators, detail and contextual information needed for clear and consistent public disclosure of individual stress test results.
title: Call to participate in the discussion on the disclosure of individual stress test results

Summary: The EBA’s final report proposes amendments to the prudential standards for central securities depositories and designated credit institutions, addressing risks arising when banking CSDs provide banking-type ancillary services to participants of other CSDs and updating references to reflect changes in EU legislation.
title: Regulatory Technical Standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’

Summary: ESMA seeks stakeholder evidence on the operational, legal, liquidity, resilience and other considerations involved in tokenising collateral used by central counterparties.
title: Call for evidence on the CCP collateral tokenisation

Summary: This instruction revokes Instruction No. 7/2019 and concerns financial information, prudential standards, credit securitisation and supervision.
title: Instrução (Histórico) n.º 8/2026

Summary: The circular clarifies how EBA/GL/2017/15 sections 5 and 8 on connected clients and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1728 apply to entities identified in Article 1 of Banco de Portugal Notice No. 11/2014, replacing Circular Letter CC/2023/00000017.
title: Carta Circular n.º CC/2026/00000022

Summary: ESMA’s final report sets out guidelines to clarify when a supplement to a base prospectus introduces a new type of security, aiming to promote consistent supervision and investor protection across the EU.
title: Final Report on the Guidelines on supplements which introduce new securities to a base prospectus

Summary: The EBA report analyses taxonomy disclosure issues under Article 8 of the Taxonomy Regulation and provides technical advice on financial-sector KPIs, grandfathering, voluntary OpEx use, group-level reporting, asset management and investment activities, and credit institution templates.
title: Report on taxonomy disclosures

Issuer: Comissão do Mercado de Valores Mobiliários (CMVM)
Summary: The CMVM communicates the FATF’s June 2026 high-risk and increased-monitoring jurisdiction updates and requires countermeasures for North Korea and Iran, enhanced due diligence for those jurisdictions and Myanmar, and risk-proportionate enhanced measures for monitored jurisdictions and other high-risk third countries.
title: Circular 006/2026 - GAFI - Prevenção e Combate ao Branqueamento de Capitais e ao Financiamento do Terrorismo

Summary: ESMA consults on draft regulatory and implementing technical standards specifying the reporting framework, including scope, content, consolidation level and format, for clearing activity at recognised third-country CCPs under EMIR Article 7d.
title: Consultation on the reporting framework under EMIR for clearing activity at recognised third-country CCPs
